sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground ('a wooded campground with 19 campsites to accommodate both tents and recreational vehicles up to 30 feet in length') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165295 (same, 'up to 30’ in length'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground ('No electricity, dump station or hook ups are available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water, trash and host only in the full-service season (Memorial Day to Labor Day weekends); may be off in the shoulder season.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground ('Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'No electricity, dump station or hook ups'; 'Visitors may expect full service between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day weekend ... services such as water, trash or a host may not be available during the fall, winter and spring'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Early May to late September, weather dependent. Rampart Range Road closes by Dec 1 each winter and reopens when conditions allow (target April 1, sometimes late May).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground ('The campground is open from early May to late September, dependent on the weather'; 'Rampart Range road is closed annually by Dec. 1 ... A target date is April 1, but weather conditions may delay opening until late May'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Strictly first come, first served with no way to check availability ahead; pay on site (cash, check or money order, or recreation.gov Scan and Pay). Run by a concessionaire: (303) 647-2366.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground ('This campground is strictly first come, first served'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165295 ('first-come, first-served basis only'; 'For facility specific information, please call (303) 647-2366'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28 a site (two vehicles or one RV); $11 a third vehicle; day use $11. Senior/Access passes halve the site fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included ... $11 fee for a third vehicle'; 'qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165295/rates (WalkInScanPay $28 for 2025 and 2027), read 2026-10-28

note: Wooded campground ~8,170 ft on Rampart Range Rd (FSR 300) near Devils Head. The only designated campground on the road that lets ATVs and dirt bikes ride in and out to the Rampart Range trails, so it fills quickly. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed 19 sites, first-come only, vault toilets, potable water, $28. Added max length 30 ft, no hookups/dump, season early May - late Sept (no dates). Website is the forest home page: own FS page given. Phone missing: South Platte RD 303-275-5610. Pin on the campground road. Note trimmed.
flags: Website is the Pike-San Isabel home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/flat-rocks-campground (recreation.gov 10165295 is only a Scan and Pay listing).
Missing phone: South Platte Ranger District 303-275-5610 (FS page 'Contact Phone'). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line, (303) 647-2366.
Operator: concessionaire-run (the FS page's pass wording 'concessionaire-run campsites'; recreation.gov contact at goexplorus.com). Ownership federal stands.
Road: Rampart Range Road 300 has an annual winter closure order (forest alerts); no other current alert names it or the campground. OHV traffic in the campground by design.
Pin = the FS point (39.32748546,-105.09220494), on the campground road in the trees west of Rampart Range Rd; no per-site coordinates to check against.
